identity: Nhal Veyr keeps the register of every Throng dead; outside its walls the Debtbound rise to collect debts nobody owes, and a mortuary clerk keeps a ledger of its own.

quests.title: Payment Due After Death
quests.text: Debtbound Zombies walk the {name:blightfields}, which lies {zone_area:blightfields}, at night, knocking to collect debts that appear nowhere in my register. Lay eight to rest before they wear their knuckles down to the last joint. Each carries a clerk's stamp, so this is an unauthorised collection conducted with an infuriating air of legitimacy.
quests.lesson: The capital's own problem, seeded for the line's climax.

quests.title: Optional: A Seat at the Table
quests.text: Bring me eight Raw Meat from the Gaunt Harts grazing the {name:blightfields} by day. Some mourners have kept vigil so long they have forgotten there is a kitchen. I set places for them anyway; a warm bowl gives the hands something to do when they have run out of things to hold.
quests.lesson: A daytime request beside a night hunt.

quests.title: My Regards Keep Better
quests.text: Sovel Namekeeper at Ossuary Ledgerstead needs help: the Gravewood around the archive has begun waking, which cannot be good for quiet study. Go and speak with Sovel, and pass along my regards. I would send a meal, but Sovel never eats, and I refuse to have my cooking filed for posterity.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the race's heartland.

quests.title: The Cost of Staying Dead
quests.text: Tithe Revenants stalk the {name:gravefields}, which lies {zone_area:gravefields}, after dark, charging the dead for being dead and the living for taking their time. Destroy eight. Their stamps bear the same clerk's mark: Hush. I have spent centuries keeping these names, and I will not have them turned into a list of debtors.
quests.lesson: A night hunt; the Debtbound Zombies there are the minor role.

quests.title: Optional: Keep It Off the Menu
quests.text: Bring me four Pickled Flesh from the Tithe Revenants in the {name:gravefields} after dark. I mean to compare the samples with my brine; someone is pickling the dead without a licence, and it is giving preservation a bad name. Hand them to me directly, please, well away from the serving bowls.
quests.lesson: A drop request that shares the revenant outing.

quests.title: Sister Errand: Hands Attached
quests.text: Brakka Jarward at Speargrass Wellhold in Speargrass Reach could use another pair of hands. Go and speak with Brakka; do keep the hands attached, since our allies tend to find the alternative unsettling. Choose one of my three sister errands to follow; I am sending you for work, not trying to misplace you.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer (one of three): the orc heartland.

quests.title: Sister Errand: Someone Turns Up
quests.text: Thorga Roadspeaker in Gor Drazhak complains that everyone wants good roads and nobody turns up to help keep them. Go and speak with Thorga; you have made a fine habit of turning up where you are needed. One of my three sister errands is enough, even if you do have an eternity to fill.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer (one of three): the orc capital.

quests.title: Sister Errand: Try to Stay Dry
quests.text: If you choose the Whispering Reedlands, speak with Taleko Drycord at Whisperreed Landing about the work there. Take care of your boots; damp gets into joints you had forgotten you owned. You need only follow one of my three sister errands, so there is no obligation to fall apart in every climate.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer (one of three): a troll heartland.

quests.title: The Account Is Closed
quests.text: {name:mortuary_clerk_hush} holds court over a ledger in the {name:tombfields}, {dir_from_giver:mortuary_clerk_hush}, entering our dead as debtors. Kill Hush, and destroy four Tithe Revenants among those tombs at night. A name is all some of these people have left, and I will not let a clerk seize it for arrears.
quests.lesson: The capital line's climax: a named normal leader.

quests.title: A Debt Freely Owed
quests.text: I have entered your service in the register, with thanks rather than a sum beside it. Go to Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise and report to Vaska Ashlistener; the Throng holds that ground against the Accord. I would prefer to hear of your next deeds from you, rather than from someone bringing me a name to enter.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the faction's contested zones.

quests.title: Bounty: The Kitchen Keeps Going
quests.text: Plague Razorbacks root through the {name:gravefields}, which lies {zone_area:gravefields}, by day, and the kitchen pays for every hunt that keeps them off the mourners' paths. Kill six and come back with the news; keep whatever meat you carve, since I am paying for the quiet, not the pork. I can offer this again thirty minutes after you hand it in, by which time someone will certainly be asking about supper.
